reasoning_content_list:
We need extract trends. Reading text: It says: "generellen Anstieg der Alpha-Diversität ... und Verlust von Spezialisten ... führte zu Homogenisierung und Verlust von Beta-Diversität". Also "Eutrophierung führt zu Veränderung, Verlust der Biodiversität, besonders lichens".

So main organism group: Plants, specifically lichens (ground lichens genus Cladonia). Also other plants nitrophilous etc.

Need entries in schema for each trend.

Trends:
- Increase alpha diversity of plants in forest across all types due to nitrophilous species.
- Decrease beta diversity at landscape level due to loss of specialist lichens.
- Loss of specialist lichens (ground lichens Cladonia) in nitrogen deficient sites.
